description: This Java class 'UpdateRolePermissionsCommandHandler' handles commands to update role permissions within the user administration module of the application. It implements a command handler interface, uses a service to perform the update, and is annotated for dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: UpdateRolePermissionsCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands to update permissions associated with a role. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and processes commands via 'processCommand' method, delegating updates to 'RoleWritePlatformService'.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a command to update role permissions by calling the service layer.
